name: relaydeck
description: Two-way tasks between your agent and the Relaydeck app on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch: the agent reports its work, and it gets your tasks, answers, and messages.

interface.longDescription: Relaydeck shows the tasks of your agent on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. The agent creates tasks, reports progress, and sends a push notification when you must act. The agent also gets the tasks, answers, and messages that you send from the app. Each API key sees only its own tasks.
